chapters.text: Every rupee in one list. Expense = spent, Money in = received, Transfer = moved between two people (not spending).
Click Expense, Money in or Transfer.

Take a photo of the bill (or choose the file) first: AMS reads the printed bill on your phone or computer and fills the amount, date, shop and the Bill details (bill no., vendor NTN and phone, tax, the rest of the text). Check them, especially the amount.
Fill what's left: who paid, category, and Paid with card if a company card was used.
Save. Bill photos are saved as PDF files (with a picture preview). The entry shows No proof until a bill is attached.
The filters bar stays at the top while you scroll; Any card shows only one card's expenses.
To repeat last month's bill, click the copy icon on that row and change date, amount and bill.
